scope: Exploratory paired archived forecast evaluation, not a deployed intervention

metric_definitions.false_notifications: Outbound notifications before the target horizon
metric_definitions.false_warning_episodes: Confirmed warning-state episodes starting before the target horizon
metric_definitions.timely_notification: Campaign has an outbound notification within the target horizon
metric_definitions.timely_warning_episode: Campaign has a new confirmed warning-state episode within the target horizon
